title: Your Own Type Traits Library
requirements: Implement in namespace `my`: `is_same`, `remove_const`, `remove_reference`, `remove_cvref`, `is_pointer`, `is_array`, `conditional`, `enable_if`, `is_integral` (via a type list), `decay`
Each trait has `_v`/`_t` helpers and a block of `static_assert` tests comparing against `std::`
